profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
• Securing 17+ Years of professional experience in the Software Industry and having been exposed to various phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and working on the development of various platforms, services, and applications.
• Worked as a team leader and an individual contributor(IC) under small to large groups, in a fast pace, process-oriented, and agile development environment.
• Excellent Interpersonal skills and an innate ability to provide motivation, and open to new and innovative ideas for the best possible solution.
• Hold various patents for my contribution to various innovative cloud-scalable solutions.

• Recent experience working on Scalable, Distributed, and Cloud-based Services and customer-facing Enterprise applications.
• Strong understanding of data structures, and algorithms, and designing scalable applications. 
• Strong understanding of T-SQL, Data Storage Engine, Data Model design, and Query Optimization. 
• Knowledge of application performance tuning using caching(client/server) and T-SQL Optimization
• Current working experience with various technologies like JAVA, MySql, JavaScript, XML, WebServices(REST, SOAP), XML, RabbitMQ, KAFKA using Eclipse.

• Experience working on E-Commerce Product that covers Payment Processing, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), website Search, User Rating and Review using C#, ASP.NET, SQL Server, AJAX, JQuery and Script# using Visual Studio.

Patents
•	All patents are related to various innovative cloud-based scalable software products.
•	US-20190278673-A1 - Failure Resistant Distributed Computing System 
•	US-20190266276-A1, US-20200233877-A1, and US-11163791-B2 - Instance Data bi-directional Replication with Transformation support
•	US-20220029887-A1 & US-11438232-B2 – Multi-source Database Engine
•	US-20230019705-A1 & US-11762668-B2 – Centralize Configuration Data Management and Control. Pending: # 18/512,807 
•	US-20220385529-A1 Dynamic Anomaly Reporting

positions.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer/Lead
positions.description:
•As Senior member, providing tech lead support to two scrum teams CMDB-experience and CMDB-application of size 10-15 Developers. Worked with the team to improve development practices, coding standards, design review process, and testing methodology.

•Improved the performance of various long-running CMDB operations that degraded the overall Database performance by impacting InnoDB History list length and causing various P1 Incidents. Redesigned and implemented features to support the scale and size of data. Example Refresh Impacted Service using persisted queue and Bloom Filter, CMDB CI User Notification, Query Builder suggested Relationship, and Reporting Metrics for CMDB Workspace.

• Designed and implemented CSDM Product Instance 2.0 bulk synchronization for Life cycle values between CMDB and Asset tables.

• Worked on POC using MemGraph to represent CMDB and Relationships as Graph to showcase the speed of querying CMDB data and Knowledge Graph.

•Lead the migration of the CMDB Data Manager feature into CMDB Workspace (Scoped App)

•Worked on Unified Map backend APIs to render the CMDB and Service Map.

positions.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer/ Lead
positions.description:
•	Technically leading the team of 10 Devs and cross-collaborated with of 2 other teams to re-implement the functionality of newly acquired startup (Sweagle: Config Data Modeling, Editing and Version Control System) that is 30% more performant than legacy.
•	Worked with Architects in ideation phase, prototyping and exploring design choices.
•	Designed and took part in implementation of complex features like Change Management, Conflict Management, Diff Comparison, Query Engine, Caching Layer, Password handling, Concurrent Request Handling and Exporter Engine.
•	Actively collaborate with dev team, doing Code Reviews, help define the standards, enforce architectural principles, and mentor team members on their deliverables.
•	Overlooked the performance testing plan with senior developers and actively work with the team to make code and database query more performant.
•	Actively engage with Product Management on future road map discussion, perform technical feasibility, create prototype, and explore design approaches.
•	Highlights of the project is complex Query Engine that I implemented to Iterate over the nodes of config data tree that get “stitched” in-memory based on various settings like Include Inherited config data and apply local overlays, substitute variables, obfuscate passwords and role based partial access.

Patent: US-20230019705-A1 & US-11762668-B2 – Centralize Configuration Data Management and Control. 
Pending: Patent# 18/512,807

positions.title: Staff SDE/Lead
positions.description:
• Worked on designing and developing the most data-intensive feature for ServiceNow CMDB Product called "Multisource". (US Patent approved)

• Worked on designing and developing Robust Transformation Engine(RTE) to ingest, transform and load data efficiently into ServiceNow CMDB.

• Lead the development effort for new product initiative related to Data Replication for ServiceNow customer. Worked on various POCs (using KAFKA and RabbitMQ) to come up with most secure, scalable and resilience replication engine design. Driven the cross-team collaboration (System Engineering, Internal Customers, Customer Support, Solution Architects..etc) to get it Production ready. (US Patent#10990605 and #11163791 approved)

• Lead the development effort of various Cloud Infrastructure Automations that manages the Lifecycle of ServiceNow Instances across the farm.Got US Patent(#9,519,553 B2 ) approval for my contribution in "Failure Resistant Distributed Computing System".

positions.title: Staff SDE
positions.description:
•Key contributor in building the Scalable Cloud Infrastructure Management Framework(CITRIS).
Developed various Solutions using CITRUS to manage and monitor the ServiceNow Instance LifeCycle (Provisioning, Move, Clone, DB Drain, Datacenter Failover..etc).

•Reduced the failure rate of various Cloud Automations drastically by developing Scalable solution to run farm wide audits.

•Worked on designing the Plugin based Solution for CITRUS2.0 using OSGI framework to achieve Development and Deployment agility.

US Patent(#9,519,553 B2 ) approval for my contribution in (CITRUS) "Failure Resistant Distributed Computing System".

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•Working on Design, development and implementation of distributed framework(CITRUS) to perform various operation inside Cloud infrastructure.

•Framework consists of JAVA agents running on every servers to perform local operation. It uses RabbitMQ (Messaging Queue) for inter agent communication. This framework allow us to orchestrate  operation across different servers in parallel and distributed way. Framework supports retry, sync, async and callback mechanism to invoke operations and supports idem potency. 

•Working on Implementing distributed orchestration to validate advance high availability and support failover for hosted web application instances in the cloud using this framework. Developing automation related to DNS, F5 BigIP pool and pool members, JVM and My SQL.

•Using open source technology and software like JAVA, MySql, Cent OS, RabbitMQ, Eclipse, Gerrit.

positions.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Worked as individual developer to implement new features and enhancement in Student Information system (SIS) using ASP.NET, C# and MySQL Server technology. Specially I contributed in measuring the performance using JMeter, finding the slow performing database queries and improve the end to end product performance.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I worked on different features for B2C platform and Market place (E-Commerce) functionality like offer search, offer details and purchase area as well User ratings and review functionality. I also worked as a key member delivering $800K Private Label Product on top of Global Scholar’s Learning Platform for Knowledge Learning Corporation (KLC).

positions.title: Software Development Eng
positions.description: I worked as Software consultant (Client side through Info Experts Inc.) in Windows Security team on internal project called SWI Track that is web based application. It is essentially a central security consulting and process improvement application for many products for Microsoft.
